decision.reasoning_trace: I evaluated a diverse set of options including a packable daypack (ZOMAKE), a tactical 35L bag (G4Free), a hydration pack (Lunidry), a cooler backpack (SEEHONOR), and a waterproof dry bag (IDRYBAG). While the ZOMAKE and IDRYBAG are excellent values at $13.99, I was primarily interested in a more robust, general-purpose backpack. The G4Free was the right capacity but reviews mentioning zippers and straps breaking after short periods of use were a significant deterrent. The Lunidry hydration pack also had reported issues with bladder leakage. Much of the rest of the product feed was cluttered with non-backpack items like camping food, patches, and stoves. Given the durability concerns with the main backpacks that fit my size requirements, I decided to wait for better options.
